About Myzel
About Myzel

Myzel is an app store for free and open source software from F-Droid repositories. It is made by needanapp.de and based on the F-Droid client.\n\nLike F-Droid itself, Myzel is free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or later.

Some apps come with behaviors you didn’t ask for — and might not want. Things like ads, tracking, or dependence on proprietary services. These are called Anti-Features. \n\nApps in Myzel are clearly labeled when they contain Anti-Features, so you can make an informed choice.

A repository is a source of apps.

Mirrors spread the downloads across several servers. Mirrors closer to you may be faster.

The official mirrors are set by the owner of the repository. They can’t be deleted, only turned off. You can add your own mirrors just like a normal repository.
